create_GPT2_tokenizer: create a GPT2 tokenizer instance with an optional cache directory for pretrained weights
tokenize_document: tokenize a text document into GPT2 tokens and append an end-of-document token
build_tokenizer_cli: build a python module to tokenize a text string using the GPT2 tokenizer and print token ids
review_Tokenizer_class: review the Tokenizer class that wraps GPT2Tokenizer with end-of-document token support
summarize_tokenize_document: summarize the tokenize_document method that encodes text and appends an EOD token
